Speculation Rises Over Sharad Pawar's NCP Joining NDA in Maharashtra

Political circles in Maharashtra are abuzz with speculation regarding the potential inclusion of Sharad Pawar's Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) into the NDA alliance. This intensified following Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde's visit to Delhi and reports of a secret meeting involving NCP leader Jayant Patil. The developments have fueled discussions about a possible shift in Maharashtra's political landscape.
